title: Negotiate aggregated discovery to find CRD-backed groups
answers: Why are CRD-backed resources missing from router discovery?
Why does introspection fail for an aggregated apiextensions-apiserver?
How should the router negotiate and decode /apis responses?
body:
Symptom: CRD-backed resource groups are missing when an apiextensions-apiserver is configured as a router aggregate target.
Root cause: pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:discoverGroups queried /apis without requesting aggregated discovery; the standalone apiextensions server's classic response contains a static group map that does not track CRDs.
Fix pattern: Request aggregatedDiscoveryJSON before application/json; pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:decodeDiscoveryResponse selects aggregated decoding when the response Content-Type contains apidiscovery.k8s.io and converts it to []metav1.APIGroup.
Constraints: Applies to active /apis discovery of aggregate targets. Preserve classic APIGroupList decoding for targets that negotiate down or ignore Accept; choose the decoder from the actual response Content-Type.
applies: Router active discovery of API groups on aggregate apiserver targets.
